title: Fix figure, table, footnote, page and cross-reference numbering
requirements:
- Replace 'Annex [X]' with the actual appendix reference
- Use 'Appendix A' consistently in contents, headings and cross-references
- Number figures and tables by section, starting at 2.1
- Adopt a single consistent figure-numbering scheme
- Check and standardise footnote numbering and references to WHO and jurisdictional AI guidance
- Ensure every printed page reference is unique, e.g. roman numerals for front matter and arabic for the body
- Use Box 1.2/1.3/1.4 in body text
- Add the conformance and testing section to the chapter overview
